part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `permuteHelperAST` (packages/babel-core/src/transformation/file/file.ts:266): when renaming a helper's internal bindings to avoid conflicts with user code, it didn't account for the helper's own export name. Renaming the user's `set`-conflicting internal function to `_set` collided with the helper's exported `_set`, producing a self-recursive function and stack overflow.

The fix adds the helper's target binding name to the conflict set, so the internal `set` function becomes `__set` while the exported `_set` remains intact — the same one-line fix as upstream Babel PR #16130.

Verified:
- `packages/babel-helpers/test/index.js` — all 12 tests pass, including the `declaration name conflict helper entrypoint` fixture (previously failing)
- `babel-core`, `transform-classes`, `transform-object-super`, `transform-runtime`, `proposal-decorators` — 1443 tests pass
- End-to-end: both issue scenarios now generate non-recursive `_set`/`__set` helper output
